We sought to replicate our previous studies with a different student population
in a different geographic location and different instructional context.

targets.title: Effects of a voluntary summer reading intervention on reading achievement: Results from a randomized field trial.
targets.evidence_quote:
We also compared the performance of control group students in moderate and high poverty
schools in this study with the two studies of READS that we were attempting to replicate. As
shown in Figure 5, in the initial studies, as in high poverty schools in this study, control group
students lost ground in the summer, d = - .07 (Kim, 2006) and d = - .08 (Kim & White, 2008).
targets.outcome_quote:
In the
Coyne et al. (2013) study, as in our study, differences in the response of comparison group
students explained the failure to replicate.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an overall failure-to-replicate verdict for their study in the conclusions. Positive effects in high-poverty schools are discussed, but the central effect did not replicate in the full sample; the overall verdict governs.
